parameters.width: Unstated, the image FILLS THE CROSS AXIS — see the note in build.
parameters.height: Sets the height of the media frame.
parameters.shape: Chooses the outline of the component.
parameters.fit: How a photograph sits in its frame. The placeholder always covers its box.
parameters.semanticLabel: What the image shows, for a screen reader. Null leaves the image decorative (silent).
parameters.media: The declared media slot id, in the media form.
